meta.title: 🤩游客照怎么拍更有活人感！！
meta.title_en: How to Make Tourist Photos Feel More Alive!!

scenes.title_cn: 顶胯：拘谨站姿换成有折线的动作
scenes.title_en: Hip Pop: Break the Stiff Stance
scenes.context: 出去玩拍照，把拘谨的站姿换成有折线的动作。顶胯动作还很显妖气。忍不住比耶的，可以把手伸出去再顶胯，稍稍改变更生动。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 出去玩拍照，把拘谨的站姿换成有折线的动作。
When traveling, swap your stiff stance for a move with angles.
a move with angles（有折线的动作）
顶胯动作，还很显妖气。
A hip pop even adds a playful edge.
a hip pop（顶胯）；playful edge（妖气）
忍不住比耶的，可以把手伸出去再顶胯。
If you can't resist a peace sign, reach your hand out and pop the hip.
reach your hand out（手伸出去）
paraphrase: 有折线 → with angles / broken lines
顶胯 → hip pop / pop the hip
scenes.speak: When traveling, swap your stiff stance for a move with angles. A hip pop even adds a playful edge. If you can't resist a peace sign, reach your hand out and pop the hip.

scenes.title_cn: 侧身挡太阳 + 背面张开双手
scenes.context: 侧身挡太阳：肩膀要顶起来，手臂打开。或者拍背面，张开双手拥抱景点。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 侧身挡太阳，然后这个肩膀要顶起来，手臂打开。
Block the sun sideways — raise that shoulder and open your arms.
block the sun（挡太阳）
或者拍背面，张开双手拥抱景点。
Or shoot from behind, arms open to hug the landmark.
hug the landmark（拥抱景点）
背影构图，更有故事感。
A back view framed this way carries more story.
a back view（背影）
paraphrase: 肩膀顶起来 → raise the shoulder / pop the shoulder
raise the shoulder · pop the shoulder
拥抱景点 → hug the landmark / embrace the view
hug the landmark · embrace the view
scenes.speak: Block the sun sideways — raise that shoulder and open your arms. Or shoot from behind, arms open to hug the landmark. A back view framed this way carries more story.

scenes.context: 把手里的东西递向镜头展示，人要往前倾，打开0.5倍广角，近大远小，画面更有张力。语域：拍照教学，动作+参数口令。
sentences: 把手里的东西递向镜头展示。
Offer what's in your hand toward the lens.
offer toward the lens（递向镜头）
人要往前倾，打开0.5倍广角。
Lean forward and switch to the 0.5x wide angle.
lean forward（往前倾）；wide angle（广角）
近大远小，画面更有张力。
Big near, small far — the frame gains tension.
the frame gains tension（画面有张力）
paraphrase: 往前倾 → lean forward / tilt in
近大远小 → big near, small far / perspective distortion
scenes.speak: Offer what's in your hand toward the lens. Lean forward and switch to the 0.5x wide angle. Big near, small far — the frame gains tension.

scenes.title_en: Walk Forward, Glance Back, Candid Shot
scenes.context: 最有氛围感的是往前走回头看抓拍。走到自己满意的角度，回头一瞬间按下快门，甜甜的氛围感就有了。语域：拍照教学，氛围感收尾。
sentences: 很有氛围感的是往前走回头看抓拍。
The most atmospheric one: walk forward, glance back, and shoot.
glance back（回头看）
走到自己满意的角度，再回头。
Walk until the angle feels right, then turn your head.
the angle feels right（满意的角度）
回头的一瞬间按下快门。
Press the shutter the moment you turn.
the moment you turn（回头一瞬间）
paraphrase: 氛围感 → atmospheric / full of vibe
回头一瞬间 → the moment you turn / right at the turn
the moment you turn · at the turn
scenes.speak: The most atmospheric one: walk forward, glance back, and shoot. Walk until the angle feels right, then turn your head. Press the shutter the moment you turn.

practice: Swap your stiff stance for a move with angles and pop the hip.
Block the sun sideways — raise that shoulder and open your arms.
Offer what's in your hand, lean forward, and use the 0.5x wide angle.
Walk forward, glance back, and press the shutter the moment you turn.
pitfalls: Swap your stiff stance for a move with angles.
「有折线」用 with angles，不是 folded lines。
Raise that shoulder and open your arms.
「肩膀顶起来」用 raise the shoulder。
Walk forward, glance back, and shoot.
shifts: 用 a move with angles（有折线）、hip pop（顶胯）、stiff stance（拘谨站姿）
用 block the sun（挡太阳）、hug the landmark（拥抱景点）、lean forward（往前倾）
用 atmospheric（氛围感）、vibe（氛围）、tension（张力）、story（故事感）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：妖戏→妖气、比叶→比耶、倒通→倒走/张开、0.5倍、吉他→其实、落寞→落幕、公路、顶胯、回头看、抓拍等。
